questionSnapshot.question: What is the name of the iconic castle at Magic Kingdom in Walt Disney World?

notes: Distinct from q110 at Disneyland, q94’s land and the suite/restaurant inside the castle. Checked all four final options, mobile wording, clue fairness, category, editorial difficulty and theatrical/character/park scope. Full topic digests and additional all-shard searches were used for distinctness; context questions are not approved by this review.

verification.context: Walt Disney World, specified park/attraction; current naming/layout at review date.

premise.reason: Magic Kingdom’s central castle is officially named Cinderella Castle.

sources.locator: Page title and introduction identify Cinderella Castle as Magic Kingdom’s symbol; A Fairytale Come to Life locates its gateway at Fantasyland.
Opening sentence: castle at entrance to Fantasyland in Magic Kingdom Park; distinguishes Disneyland’s Sleeping Beauty Castle later in the same paragraph.

challenge.notes: Fixed location in the original wording is decisive: Disneyland’s Sleeping Beauty Castle does not become correct merely because it is also a Disney icon. The remaining names do not match the official Magic Kingdom name.
